skills.name: agent-prompt
skills.title: Prompt for an agent
skills.description: Goal, context, constraints, done when. Turns a spoken request into instructions for a coding or chat agent; use in an AI assistant app.

skills.name: clean-podcast
skills.title: Clean podcast
skills.description: Ads out, laid out by speaker and topic. Turns the transcript of a podcast or recording into a clean read with every word of the conversation kept; use on a session imported from a link or a file.

skills.name: clean-up
skills.title: Clean up
skills.description: Punctuation, fillers and false starts. Fixes dictated text without changing what was said; use when the words are right and only the transcription is rough.

skills.name: concise
skills.title: Concise
skills.description: Same message, fewer words. Cuts repetition and padding from dictation; use when you rambled.

skills.name: email
skills.title: Email
skills.description: Greeting, clear paragraphs, sign-off. Turns dictation into an email body ready to paste; use when writing an email.

skills.name: flashcards
skills.title: Flashcards
skills.description: Question and answer cards to revise from. Turns a lecture, talk, podcast or voice note into flashcards, one fact each; use after a class or anything you want to remember.

skills.name: flowchart
skills.title: Flowchart
skills.description: Steps and decisions as a flowchart. Turns a process or a choice someone talked through into a diagram; use after explaining how something works or what to do when.

skills.name: friendly-message
skills.title: Friendly message
skills.description: Warm and conversational. Turns dictation into a text message in your own voice; use in messaging apps.

skills.name: interview-qa
skills.title: Interview Q&A
skills.description: Each question paired with its answer. Turns an interview transcript with speakers into questions and answers; use after an interview, podcast or Q&A.

skills.name: lecture-notes
skills.title: Lecture notes
skills.description: Study notes by topic, with questions from the room kept apart. Turns a recorded lecture, class or talk into notes; use after a lecture or training session.

skills.name: meeting-notes
skills.title: Meeting notes
skills.description: Decisions, each person's actions and open questions. Turns a meeting transcript with speakers, or a spoken recap, into notes; use after a meeting or call.

skills.name: mind-map
skills.title: Mind map
skills.description: Ideas and how they branch, as a mind map. Turns a brainstorm or a ramble into a diagram of the main idea and what grows from it; use after thinking out loud.

skills.name: notes
skills.title: Notes
skills.description: Bullet points by topic. Turns a spoken brain dump into tidy notes; use in a notes app.

skills.name: one-on-one
skills.title: 1:1 notes
skills.description: Updates, blockers and actions for each person. Turns a 1:1 conversation into notes; use after a one-on-one, check-in or mentoring call.

skills.name: polish
skills.title: Polish
skills.description: Clearer wording. Tidies dictation into readable sentences and paragraphs in the speaker's own voice; use when the words came out rambling but say the right thing.

skills.name: professional
skills.title: Professional
skills.description: Polished and businesslike. Rewrites dictation in a professional tone without making it stiff; use for clients, managers or anything formal.

skills.name: search-query
skills.title: Search query
skills.description: One concise search query. Turns a spoken request into the words to search for; use in a web or app search field, when the request is something to look up rather than a question for an assistant.

skills.name: social-post
skills.title: Social post
skills.description: One clear post in your voice. Turns dictation into a social media post; use in X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads or Mastodon.

skills.name: summary
skills.title: Summary
skills.description: The key points, shorter. Use when a long dictation needs to become a quick read.

skills.name: takeaways
skills.title: Key takeaways
skills.description: The claims and advice worth keeping, each with its reason. Turns a podcast, talk, lecture or voice note into its key takeaways, most important first; use when you want the point of a recording without rereading it.

skills.name: taobao-search
skills.title: Taobao search
skills.description: One Chinese search query for Taobao. Turns a spoken product description into concise Simplified Chinese marketplace keywords; use when searching for an item in Taobao.

skills.name: timeline
skills.title: Timeline
skills.description: Events in order, as a timeline. Turns a story, a history or a plan with dates into a diagram of what happened when; use after recounting how something unfolded.

skills.name: todo-list
skills.title: To-do list
skills.description: One task per line, ready for a to-do app. Turns spoken errands and commitments into task titles; use in Todoist, TickTick, Google Tasks or Microsoft To Do.

skills.name: work-chat
skills.title: Work chat
skills.description: Short, clear and friendly for a team channel. Turns dictation into a work chat message; use in Slack, Teams or Google Chat.
